t: 10 Interesting Examples of Ancient Graffiti - Oldest.org
s: March 20, 2025 - These days, tourists are notorious for vandalizing ancient structures by writing their names or drawing something silly, if not offensive. It’s almost funny to realize how little we have changed, as the Ancient Romans did much the same when visiting Egyptian ruins. Graffiti, whether a form of art or a form of protest, has persisted for thousands of years.
